items.title: New UKMTO warning: outbound tanker reports waterline explosion near Hormuz
items.summary: UKMTO published Warning 197-26 on November 6 about an outbound tanker reporting an explosion near Khasab, Oman, on November 5. The crew is safe and the vessel continued under its own power. The warning establishes a fresh maritime security incident report but not attacker identity, a new transit shutdown, or measured lost oil supply.

observations.label: UKMTO warning
observations.value: 197-26, classified as attack; published November 6, 2026

observations.label: Reported incident time and location
observations.value: November 5, 22:00 UTC; 16 nautical miles east of Khasab, Oman

observations.label: Vessel and crew status
observations.value: Outbound tanker, waterline explosion on port side; crew safe; vessel proceeding under own power

observations.label: Verified physical-flow impact
observations.value: No confirmed wider reduction in tanker transit or petroleum throughput from this warning

observations.label: Related official maritime advisories
observations.value: MARAD 2026-011 (Hormuz) and 2026-013 (Red Sea) active

items.key_finding: An independently documented UKMTO tanker incident renews Hormuz security risk without establishing disrupted regional oil flows.

sources.title: UK Maritime Trade Operations — Recent incidents, Warning 197-26

items.title: US chip shares rebound after global rout, with breadth still mixed
items.summary: US chipmakers rebounded sharply in Friday's morning trading after Thursday's extreme selling, helping lift the Nasdaq while the Dow lagged. The recovery signals a partial reversal in positioning, not verified improvement in semiconductor orders or data-center deployment economics. Higher Treasury yields and narrow leadership could challenge durability.

items.title: Cloudflare surges on accelerating revenue and stronger guidance
items.summary: Cloudflare reported third-quarter revenue growth of 39%, its fastest in nearly four years, and forecast fourth-quarter revenue ahead of consensus. Shares advanced sharply during Friday's early session despite broader software and AI volatility. Strong demand and improved adjusted operating income contrast with a continuing GAAP loss and valuation risk.

items.title: U.S. jobs report substantially exceeds expectations
items.summary: October payroll growth exceeded the Reuters consensus, while unemployment edged lower. The report suggests greater labor-market resilience; the Scout's assessment is that persistent interest-rate pressure remains a risk to technology valuations. Watch Treasury yields, inflation data and subsequent payroll revisions.

observations.label: October nonfarm payroll growth — November 6 release
observations.value: +165,000; Reuters consensus +65,000

observations.label: October unemployment rate
observations.value: 4.1%, versus 4.2% expected

items.key_finding: Stronger-than-expected employment supports economic resilience while keeping interest-rate risk in focus.

items.title: Lam Research authorizes $25 billion in share repurchases
items.summary: Lam announced a large repurchase authorization and its quarterly dividend during semiconductor-sector repricing. The Scout views the announcement as evidence of management's capital-return priorities, while customer spending remains a key risk. Authorization permits purchases but does not establish that shares have been repurchased.

observations.label: November 5 board announcement
observations.value: $25 billion share-repurchase authorization, supplementing prior remaining balances

observations.label: Quarterly dividend
observations.value: $0.33 per share; payable January 6, 2027 to holders of record December 2, 2026

observations.label: Repurchase conditions
observations.value: No termination date; may be suspended or discontinued; no obligation to purchase

items.key_finding: The authorization is a material capital-allocation announcement, not a guarantee of executed buybacks or future equipment demand.

sources.title: Lam Research — November 5, 2026 repurchase authorization and dividend release
